import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
import re
from wordcloud import WordCloud
from collections import Counter


df = pd.read_csv('../data/csv/berita-mul.csv') 
print("🔎 Ukuran dataset:", df.shape)
print("📊 Info dataframe:")
print(df.info())


print("\n📌 Contoh 5 data teratas:")
print(df.head())


print("\n❗ Jumlah missing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())


plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='kategori', order=df['kategori'].value_counts().index)
plt.title('Distribusi Berita per Kategori')
plt.ylabel('Jumlah Berita')
plt.xticks(rotation=30)
plt.show()


df['panjang_teks'] = df['berita'].astype(str).apply(len)
df['jumlah_kata'] = df['berita'].astype(str).apply(lambda x: len(x.split()))

plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
sns.histplot(df['jumlah_kata'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribusi Jumlah Kata dalam Berita')
plt.xlabel('Jumlah Kata')
plt.ylabel('Frekuensi')
plt.show()

print("\n📊 Statistik jumlah kata:")
print(df['jumlah_kata'].describe())


def bersihkan_teks(teks):
    teks = teks.lower()
    teks = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', '', teks)
    return teks

all_words = " ".join(df['berita'].astype(str).apply(bersihkan_teks)).split()
word_counts = Counter(all_words)
print("\n🔠 20 kata yang paling sering muncul:")
print(word_counts.most_common(20))


wordcloud = WordCloud(width=1000, height=600, background_color='white').generate(" ".join(all_words))
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation='bilinear')
plt.axis('off')
plt.title('🌥️ WordCloud dari Isi Berita')
plt.show()


print("\n📜 Berita terpanjang:")
print(df.loc[df['jumlah_kata'].idxmax(), ['judul', 'jumlah_kata']])
print("\n📜 Berita terpendek:")
print(df.loc[df['jumlah_kata'].idxmin(), ['judul', 'jumlah_kata']])

# 1️⃣ Membaca data
df = pd.read_csv('../data/csv/spam-mul.csv', index_col=0, encoding="Windows-1252")
df = df[['Text']]


print("🔎 Ukuran dataset:", df.shape)
print(df.head())

# Jika belum ada kolom label, buat kolom 'label' dummy (spam vs ham belum diketahui)
# (Biasanya dataset spam punya kolom 'label', tapi kalau belum kita lanjut analisa teksnya saja)

# 2️⃣ Analisis panjang teks
df['char_length'] = df['Text'].astype(str).apply(len)
df['word_count'] = df['Text'].astype(str).apply(lambda x: len(x.split()))

print("\n📊 Statistik panjang teks:")
print(df[['char_length', 'word_count']].describe())

plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
sns.histplot(df['word_count'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribusi Jumlah Kata dalam SMS')
plt.xlabel('Jumlah Kata')
plt.ylabel('Frekuensi')
plt.show()

# 3️⃣ Cek penggunaan angka, simbol, dan huruf kapital
df['num_count'] = df['Text'].astype(str).apply(lambda x: len(re.findall(r'\d+', x)))
df['upper_ratio'] = df['Text'].astype(str).apply(lambda x: sum(1 for c in x if c.isupper()) / len(x))

print("\n📈 Statistik angka dan kapitalisasi:")
print(df[['num_count', 'upper_ratio']].describe())

# 4️⃣ Top 20 kata yang paling sering muncul
def bersihkan_teks(teks):
    teks = teks.lower()
    teks = re.sub(r'[^a-z\s]', '', teks)
    return teks

all_words = " ".join(df['Text'].astype(str).apply(bersihkan_teks)).split()
word_counts = Counter(all_words)
print("\n🔠 20 kata yang paling sering muncul:")
print(word_counts.most_common(20))

# 5️⃣ WordCloud untuk teks
wordcloud = WordCloud(width=800, height=500, background_color='white').generate(" ".join(all_words))
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation='bilinear')
plt.axis('off')
plt.title('🌥️ WordCloud Pesan SMS')
plt.show()

# 6️⃣ Cek pola indikasi spam (kata kunci umum)
spam_keywords = ['free', 'win', 'prize', 'call', 'claim', 'urgent', 'txt', 'sms', 'cash']
for kw in spam_keywords:
    df[f'contains_{kw}'] = df['Text'].astype(str).str.contains(kw, case=False, regex=False)

keyword_freq = df[[f'contains_{kw}' for kw in spam_keywords]].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
keyword_freq.plot(kind='bar', color='orange')
plt.title('📊 Frekuensi Kata Kunci Spam dalam Pesan')
plt.ylabel('Jumlah Pesan Mengandung Kata')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
